T:P1.2.text: Butler National Corporation specializes in aerospace solutions and management services, including modifications.

T:P1.3.text: AVCON RECEIVES FAA STC FOR HONEYWELL AEROSPACE REPLACEMENT EGPWS ON BOMBARDIER AND LEARJET AIRCRAFT

T:P1.4.text: BUTLER NATIONAL CORPORATION ANNOUNCES INCREASE TO STOCK REPURCHASE PROGRAM

T:P1.5.text: Butler National Corporation is an aerospace-focused holding company that delivers engineering, aircraft modifications, electrical systems integration, commercial and defense electronics, and professional management services. Our businesses support commercial operators, defense partners, and original equipment manufacturers.

T:P1.6.text: Our primary operations include Avcon Industries, BNC Tempe, and the professional services segment anchored by the Boot Hill Casino. Together, these businesses combine advanced engineering with reliable service delivery to support long-term growth.

T:P1.8.text: Butler National Corporation is comprised of multiple key subsidiaries operating across industries such as aerospace, avionics, defense, and professional services.

T:P1.9.text: Avcon provides FAA-approved aircraft modifications, engineering, avionics and electrical systems integration, and special mission solutions.

T:P1.10.text: BNC Tempe supplies commercial and defense electronics, wiring harnesses, and system controls to OEMs and government agencies.

T:P1.11.text: Our professional services segment provides management and operational expertise in gaming and hospitality.

T:P1.12.text: Butler National offers opportunities across engineering, avionics, electronics manufacturing, and management services. Explore open roles across our business units.

T:P1.13.text: Subscribe to receive Butler National Corporation updates and investor communications.

T:P2.2.text: Aerospace expertise in designing, manufacturing, and servicing aviation products and professional services, managing Boot Hill Casino.

T:P2.3.text: Butler National Corporation is a public holding company with more than six decades of experience in aerospace engineering, aircraft modifications, avionics integration, special purpose electronics design and manufacturing, and professional gaming management services.

T:P2.4.text: Butler National is OTCQX listed under the ticker BUKS.

T:P2.5.text: Butler National oversees subsidiaries that provide:

T:P2.6.text: Aircraft modifications, avionics and electrical systems integration, and special mission solutions

T:P2.7.text: Commercial and defense electronics, wire/cable harness assemblies, and system components

T:P2.8.text: Professional management services for gaming operations

T:P2.9.text: This combination of engineering capability and disciplined operational management supports sustainable growth across our business segments.

T:P2.10.text: Our governance framework includes established committees, corporate policies, charters, and a code of ethics that guide responsible conduct across all subsidiaries.

T:P2.11.text: Our operating subsidiaries focus on aerospace engineering and modifications, commercial electronics, and professional management services.

T:P2.12.text: Avcon provides FAA approved aircraft modifications, engineering, avionics and electrical systems integration, and special mission solutions.

T:P3.2.text: Operates Avcon Inc. and Butler Avionics, supplies commercial and defense electronics, manages Boot Hill Casino & Resort, and runs KC Machine.

T:P3.3.text: Butler National Corporation oversees a group of aerospace and professional services subsidiaries that support commercial operators, defense partners, original equipment manufacturers and agencies around the world. Our primary operations focus on aircraft engineering and modifications, avionics integration, and commercial electronics design and manufacturing, with additional services provided through our professional management segment.

T:P3.4.text: Our aerospace subsidiaries deliver engineering, FAA-approved aircraft modifications, avionics integration, commercial electronics, wiring systems, and special mission solutions. These businesses support a broad range of commercial, defense, and government programs.

C:S1.1.text: Seven operating hotel-casino properties and seven gaming-only taverns make up the company's Las Vegas-area portfolio. Its Wildfire brand covers smaller casinos without hotel rooms.

C:S2.1.text: Red Rock Resorts, Inc. is a publicly traded holding company that owns a portion of Station Casinos. Through Station Casinos LLC it runs major properties and smaller ones across the Las Vegas valley.

C:S3.1.text: Red Rock Casino, Resort & Spa sits in Summerlin and is Station Casinos' flagship property. The company's corporate headquarters is located on the property.

C:S4.1.text: The company is the Las Vegas locals casino operator, not a Strip company, selling to residents of Clark County rather than to tourists.
